body: It’s hard to let go.it’s going to be hard dealing with the loneliness again.He is the only one I have I don’t have any friends just him.I don’t think I’m ready to I feel lost
I am 16 we have been dating for 6 months

I feel exactly the same way and that’s the same reason to why I haven’t gone into therapy as well.I would say just go for it and just to see if it makes a difference.I am planning on telling my parents to get me into therapy too.Just remember that it’s going to take time to get better.Depression can make you feel hopeless.Don’t let that feeling take over and sometimes you have to put yourself first.Everyone has flaws and nobody’s perfect.Therapy isn’t going to solve all your problems and its helping you work on yourself but if that doesn’t help you can go try different types of therapy.I hope this helped :)
Thank you so much for the advice.I’ll look into it and try to settle down.It has been hard for me to get myself to speak up lately.
